description: Returns one identified room in the selected wedding, with its property, description, capacity, status, stay details and stored price and deposit overrides, plus its place's id, name, stored room-choice override and effective mode. Missing, removed and other-wedding rooms return the same not-found result. Guest assignments and occupant identities are excluded. Requires sign-in.

accommodation_id.description: Identifier of a room in the selected wedding.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: get_my_accommodation
title: Get My Wedding Accommodation
